You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Brake assist - Stop right there.  Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now!  With brake assist, you will.  It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one. Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed.  If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them. description: 2018 Hyundai Santa Fe SE: Your Versatile All-Wheel Drive Companion Imagine a crisp Saturday morning in Quincy Township, PA, where the mist is just lifting off the rolling farmlands. You are loading up the family for a day trip, and the 2018 Hyundai Santa Fe SE stands ready in the driveway, finished in its sophisticated Night Sky Pearl paint. Whether you are heading out for a scenic drive through the Appalachian foothills or navigating the quiet, historic streets of Emmitsburg, MD, this SUV is designed to blend seamlessly into your lifestyle. It offers the perfect balance of space for the kids and the capability required for the changing seasons of south-central Pennsylvania. This is more than just a vehicle; it is a reliable partner for those who value community, nature, and the comfort of a well-appointed cabin during their daily travels. Robust V6 Performance and All-Wheel Drive Capability Under the hood of this Santa Fe SE lies a powerful 3.3L V-6 gasoline direct injection engine, delivering a stout 290HP. This isn't just about speed; it is about the confidence to merge onto the highway or climb the gently rolling terrain near Mont Alto, PA, even when the vehicle is fully loaded with passengers and gear. The engine features an Aluminum engine block and DOHC variable valve control, ensuring efficient power delivery across the rev range. Paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission featuring SHIFTRONIC manual shift mode and an OD lock-up torque converter, the driving experience is smooth and responsive. The Automatic full-time All-Wheel Drive system is a vital asset for local drivers, providing essential traction when winter weather arrives or when navigating the gravel roads common in our more rural service areas. Drivers can further customize their experience using the Driver selectable drivetrain mode and the Active Eco selectable mode, allowing you to prioritize efficiency or performance based on the day's agenda. The mechanical foundation is rounded out by a Multi-Link Rear Suspension and Strut Front Suspension, both utilizing coil springs to soak up road imperfections, while the Transmission oil cooler ensures long-term durability during summer hauls. Integrated Technology and Smart Connectivity In today's world, staying connected is a necessity, and the 2018 Hyundai Santa Fe SE makes it effortless. The center stack features a 7 inch primary touchscreen display that serves as the hub for your media and communication. With Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smart device mirroring, you can safely access your favorite navigation apps, playlists, and contacts directly through the vehicle's interface. For those who prefer a hands-off approach, the Handsfree Bluetooth wireless device connectivity and Voice activated audio controls allow you to keep your focus on the road while making calls or changing the music. The tech suite also includes Turn-by-Turn Navigation Directions, ensuring you never lose your way when exploring the scenic backroads of Germany Township, PA. Passengers will appreciate the Streaming Audio capabilities and the conveniently located USB port for keeping devices charged. Information is delivered clearly through an Analog instrumentation display which includes an Exterior temperature display, keeping you informed of changing weather conditions as you move through the foothills. Every control is within easy reach, including Steering wheel mounted audio controls, allowing for a distraction-free environment. Premium Comfort and Spacious Three-Row Interior The interior of the Santa Fe SE is designed with the modern family in mind, featuring a spacious 7-passenger seating capacity. The cabin is draped in Gray YES Essentials premium cloth, a material specifically chosen for its durability and resistance to stainsâ€perfect for active families returning from a hike or a local school event. The 8-Way Power Driver Seat includes 4-way power lumbar support, providing personalized comfort for long commutes or weekend errands. To ensure everyone stays comfortable, the Dual-zone front automatic climate control is supplemented by Third-row climate control with separate controls and Rear headliner/pillar climate control ducts, meaning no one is left in a hot or cold spot. Versatility is at the heart of this SUV's design. The 40-20-40 folding second-row seats feature manual recline and fore/aft movement, while the 50-50 folding third-row passenger seat can be manually folded into the floor to expand your cargo area. Practical touches abound, such as the Heated windshield wiper park and Heated door mirrors, which make frosty mornings much easier to manage. With 4 12V DC Power Outlets and a Mini overhead console with storage, there is a dedicated place for all your gadgets and essentials. Comprehensive Safety and Driver Protection Safety is a cornerstone of the Hyundai brand, and this Santa Fe SE is equipped with a comprehensive suite of protective features. The vehicle is built with Fully galvanized steel body panels and Side impact beams to provide a rigid safety cell. Inside, you are protected by a total of 7 airbags, including a Driver knee airbag and Curtain 1st and 2nd row airbags. The Airbag occupancy sensor ensures that the dual-stage front airbags deploy appropriately based on the passenger's presence. Active safety systems work behind the scenes to keep you in control. The 4-Wheel Disc Brakes are enhanced by ABS Brakes and a Brake assist system, providing maximum stopping power when it matters most. When backing out of a driveway or parking spot, the Back-Up Camera provides a clear view of your surroundings. For families, the Manual rear child safety door locks offer peace of mind, while the Electronic stability control and Traction control systems help maintain composure on slick surfaces. Sophisticated Exterior and Purposeful Design The exterior of the Santa Fe SE is both functional and stylish, highlighted by the deep Night Sky Pearl finish. The front profile is defined by a Chrome grille and Projector beam halogen headlights with LED daytime running lights, providing excellent visibility and a modern aesthetic. The body-colored bumpers feature Metal-look inserts, adding a touch of rugged sophistication that fits right in at a community gathering in Mount Pleasant Township, PA. Practicality is enhanced by the Full roof rack with Roof rails, allowing you to carry extra gear for outdoor adventures. The 18-inch machined aluminum wheels provide a planted stance, while the Rear lip spoiler adds a subtle sporty flair. For added convenience, the Auto on/off headlight control and Remote activated perimeter approach lighting ensure the path is always illuminated when you arrive or depart after dark. Key Highlights The 2018 Hyundai Santa Fe SE offers a robust list of features designed for the modern driver:  3.3L V6 Engine - Provides 290HP for confident passing and merging. All-Wheel Drive - Ensures superior traction in all weather conditions. 7-Passenger Seating - Ample room for the whole family and their friends. Apple CarPlay & Android Auto - Seamless smartphone integration for music and maps. Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control - Individual comfort settings for front passengers. YES Essentials Cloth - Stain-resistant upholstery perfect for active lifestyles.
